query: Who was the British monarch when the Eiffel Tower was finished?
answer:
Queen Victoria was the British monarch at the time. The Eiffel Tower was finished on 31 March 1889 as the centrepiece of the 1889 World's Fair in Paris [1][2]. Victoria reigned over the United Kingdom from 1837 until 1901 [3], so the tower was completed about 52 years into her 63-year reign, two years after her Golden Jubilee in 1887.
